title: What the top ten became
subtitle: The ten scored priorities, placed on the release that carried them. Eight had a named release across November 2024 and 2025, and ten further releases followed in early 2026.
note: The first two out were the five-hour break warning and the supervisor break hard stop, ranked one and two. Both were compliance items the old warnings list had buried.
source: Top ten prioritisation and release plan, Time and Attendance Findings Report, October 2024.
